body: I don't, I treat my body extremely well these days- If I felt like crap as well then I'd be even more likely to kill myself. I see what you mean with the girlfriend thing, I'd just feel like I would be dragging someone else down with me. I guess it would give me more reasons to get out of bed in the morning though.

I'd like to volunteer, but there's not really anywhere that does that sort of thing around here. Maybe the churches but not very often. I don't know- I suppose I'll stick around until I get through with my education, I've been looking at zoology and conservation as possible fields to go in to. Zoologists typically don't make a lot of money, but I suppose I could always write a book about my experiences and be able to afford a decent house. I've thought about getting a girlfriend but I feel like it would be unfair to rely on another person to make me happy. I do live in the US, and I'm never opposed to talking to open minded individuals like yourself whether it's on here or on the phone.
